title: India AI Impact Summit 2026 — Sovereign MANAV Vision, Frontier Commitments & BHASHINI Stack
summary: PM Narendra Modi unveiled MANAV Vision for AI: Moral systems, Accountable governance, National sovereignty, Accessible & inclusive, Valid & legitimate.

blocks.content: **Overview**: PM Narendra Modi unveiled MANAV Vision for AI: Moral systems, Accountable governance, National sovereignty, Accessible & inclusive, Valid & legitimate.

items: **MANAV Vision for AI at India AI Impact Summit 2026** (Page 5): PM Narendra Modi unveiled MANAV Vision for AI: Moral systems, Accountable governance, National sovereignty, Accessible & inclusive, Valid & legitimate.

**NPCI offers 'UPI One World' wallet to foreign visitors at AI Summit** (Page 21): NPCI offered UPI One World wallet for delegates from 40+ countries at India AI Impact Summit (up to ₹25,000 per load, max ₹50,000/month).

**NPCI launches FiMI domain-specific language model for payments** (Page 22): NPCI launched FiMI (Finance Model for India) Small Language Model supporting English, Hindi, Telugu, Bengali on UPI Help Assistant.
**NPCI and Nvidia tie up for sovereign AI payment infrastructure** (Page 23): NPCI partnered with Nvidia to scale FiMI SLM infrastructure for sovereign payments.
**Bharat GenAI text models across 22 scheduled languages led by IIT Bombay** (Page 31): DST funded ₹235 Cr under NM-ICPS + MeitY India AI Mission ₹10,585 Cr for BharatGen sovereign multilingual LLM.

**India AI Impact Summit 2026 held in New Delhi: Seven Chakras & 3 Sutras** (Page 37): First-ever Global AI Summit in Global South (Feb 16-20) based on People, Planet, Progress. Stanford AI Index 2025 ranks India top 3 in AI vibrancy.
**MeitY launches VoicERA open-source voice AI stack on BHASHINI** (Page 42): Amitabh Nag (CEO BHASHINI) launched VoicERA in collaboration with EkStep, IIIT Bengaluru, AI4Bharat.
**India unveils 'New Delhi Frontier AI Commitments' at AI Summit** (Page 45): Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled voluntary Frontier AI commitments adopted by global and Indian tech leaders.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Sovereign AI Governance & Multilingual Stack. Global South AI summit establishing MANAV and 22-language stack.
